title: Resource limits: separate pools, internal renderer workers accounted, pause and throttle block admission, no LLM polling
note: Synthetic. Lists the function exercised, the input and the expected outcome; authored, not run. No number here is a measurement of real rendering, latency, memory or cost.

calls.case: workers 4 with RASANAI_WORKERS_PER_RENDER_UNIT unset; workers unset
crew/throttle.json model_job until 60 s from now
needs browser_capture 1 + video_render 2 on a machine whose render pool has 2 slots
a child process that exits 0 after 40 s, then one killed by shouldCancel
managed child launched under a held slot

expect: 4 workers = 2 units; unset workers = 1 unit with internal_workers unknown and unaccounted true (never a precise-looking number)
paused: state paused, reason_code user_paused, no slot touched
throttled: state queued, reason_code provider_throttled with retry-after seconds
two render units fit exactly in a 2-slot pool; a third unit would be demand_exceeds_pool (resource_blocked), not clamped

the supervisor emits queued, admitted (queue wait and fencing generations), started, heartbeat (rss from ps, no model), finished with duration and peak_rss_mb; a cancelled child is reported cancelled and its slots released
the child sees RASANAI_MANAGED=1 and RASANAI_SLOT_OWNER; an agent cap above the pool size never disables the render limiter
